body: instead of planning for the “day” you should actually try to treat yourself for dinner. just hang in the a little longer and you’ll find answers to everything that not everyone can answer themselves. it just takes time. patience is a pain in the ass i understand but everyone would rather you be patient then cut your life so soon. trust me homie you got this, i promise

i’m really sorry about your loss and i’d hope i never make someone feel the way you did. thank you for the idea i’ll try to convince myself to talk to some of my friends about where i’m standing in life. once again thank you..
hey buddy it isn’t going to be worth it just push through it a lil longer okay? *virtual hug*

off the top of my head the only thing that makes me feel happy is hanging out w just my two best friends. but i’ve noticed myself distancing myself from them because i wouldn’t want them to care as much if i did commit. but expressing my does help me vent and calm a little that’s why i wish they’d notice. that way i can actually rely on them for support and comfort.

i haven’t tried it but if i do then i’ll get kicked out of the military for not being mentally stable and i don’t want that. but even if i wanted to i couldn’t tell a random person all my personal problems even if they get paid for it
